candidates.sentence: Scott Perry knows that we must keep our promise to our Seniors, by preserving and protecting Medicare and Social Security…
He opposes late-term and partial birth abortion, as well as forcing Taxpayers to fund abortion.
keep our promise to our Seniors, by preserving and protecting Medicare and Social Security.
Scott Perry – whose grandmother emigrated from Colombia in search of greater freedom and opportunity for her family supports a strong, legal immigration system.

He supports parental consent for procedures involving a minor, and supports the defunding of Planned Parenthood and shifting its funding to local health clinics to provide valuable women’s health services.

He’s the grandson of Colombian immigrants, and the son of a single mom who fled two abusive situations and worked several jobs to survive and support her children – with whom she finally landed in Central Pennsylvania in their first home on Berryhill Street in Harrisburg, then landed permanently in Dillsburg.
